buildingExclusions.sourceText: amenity=university; building=hospital; building:levels=10; name=School of Medicine
buildingExclusions.reason: A hospital building (building=hospital) on Christchurch Hospital's grounds, with no operator tag. amenity=university and its name, School of Medicine, do not say which university's it is, so OpenStreetMap does not trace it to Otago: a building of another body is shown as Otago's only where its own tags say so, as for the Malaghan Institute at VUW. The surroundings draw it as they draw any other building, unless it overlaps one of Otago's buildings on the map or covers less than 12 square metres.
